mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year inflation rate exceeding 2.0% signals that the Federal Reserve may tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.0% is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint improvement in the labor market, indicated by rising non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals stronger consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE < 5.5% AND PAYEMS MoM growth > 0.5%) fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening residential demand, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST declines, or the Rank IC for HOUST decline in late-cycle is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for UNRATE decline remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods of declining UNRATE are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month growth rate in industrial production below 0.5% signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic deceleration and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for INDPRO MoM growth < 0.5% is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in residential sales (RSAFS) and a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) signals strong housing market activity under accommodative monetary policy, which supports economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (RSAFS growth > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery phase, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening manufacturing activity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances during post-recession recovery when INDPRO increases, or the Rank IC for INDPRO increase in post-recession recovery is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
